skills.name: walkForward
skills.description: Walks forward for a specific duration.

skills.name: sayHello
skills.description: Says hello in chat.

skills.name: lookAt
skills.description: Looks at specific coordinates.
skills.codeExample:
const vec3 = require('vec3');
bot.lookAt(vec3(x, y, z));

skills.name: mmskills.move.walk
skills.description: Walks continuously in the specified direction. If distance is provided, stops automatically after traveling that many blocks or getting stuck.

skills.name: mmskills.move.run
skills.description: Sprints continuously in the specified direction. If distance is provided, stops automatically after traveling that many blocks or getting stuck.

skills.name: mmskills.move.lookat
skills.description: Changes the bot's camera viewing angle to the specified pitch and yaw.

skills.name: mmskills.move.jump
skills.description: Makes the bot jump once.

skills.name: mmskills.move.sneak
skills.description: Changes the sneaking (crouching) state of the bot.

skills.name: mmskills.block.place
skills.description: Equips the specified block from inventory and places it on the face of the block the bot is currently looking at. Will fail if block is not in inventory or bot is not looking at an adjacent block.

skills.name: mmskills.block.break
skills.description: Breaks the block the bot is currently looking at. Does not require coordinates because it targets the cursor block. This is an asynchronous task.

skills.name: mmskills.block.interact
skills.description: Interacts with (e.g. right-clicks) the block the bot is currently looking at (like a door, button, or chest).

skills.name: mmskills.entity.interact
skills.description: Interacts with the nearest entity within 5 blocks that the bot is looking at.

skills.name: mmskills.entity.attack
skills.description: Attacks the nearest entity (mob, player, or animal) within 5 blocks that the bot is looking at.

skills.name: mmskills.ai.saveExperience
skills.description: Saves a successful strategy or learning experience to the AI's permanent memory. Use this after completing a complex task successfully to remember how to do it in the future.
skills.codeExample: mmskills.ai.saveExperience('How to craft a boat', 'I needed 5 wooden planks. I opened the crafting table and placed them in a U shape.');

skills.name: mmskills.ai.setEmergencyMode
skills.description: Manually triggers or stops emergency mode (0.2s ultra-fast visual polling). Extremely useful when doing parkour, intense combat, or tasks requiring split-second decisions.
parameters: durationMs (optional, only used if state is time)

skills.name: mmskills.inventory.items
skills.description: Returns an array of serialized item objects currently in the inventory.

skills.name: mmskills.inventory.unequip
skills.description: Unequips an item from a specific destination (e.g., 'hand', 'head', 'torso', 'legs', 'feet', 'off-hand').

skills.name: mmskills.inventory.equip
skills.description: Equips an item by its name (e.g. 'iron_sword') or by passing a serialized item object, to a specific destination (e.g. 'hand').

skills.name: mmskills.inventory.toss
skills.description: Tosses a specific item type (number ID) from the inventory. Optional metadata and count can be provided.

skills.name: mmskills.inventory.craft
skills.description: Crafts an item using a 2x2 (inventory) or 3x3 (crafting table) grid. Throws an error if failed. For 3x3, the bot MUST be looking at a crafting_table.
parameters: targetItemIdentifier (string name, id, or item object)

skills.name: mmskills.inventory.isOpenUI
skills.description: Checks if a chest/crafting UI was just opened (returns true for 0.08 seconds after opening).

skills.name: mmskills.window.current
skills.description: Returns the currently opened UI window object (or null if none). Contains id, type, title, and slots array.

skills.name: mmskills.window.leftClick
skills.description: Left clicks a specific slot in the currently opened window.

skills.name: mmskills.window.rightClick
skills.description: Right clicks a specific slot in the currently opened window.

skills.name: mmskills.window.shiftClick
skills.description: Shift clicks a specific slot in the currently opened window to move items quickly.

skills.name: mmskills.ai.saveSpatialMemory
skills.description: Saves spatial long-term memory (route, coordinates, and screenshot file path) so the AI can recall it later using Execute: 'FlashBack'.
skills.codeExample: mmskills.ai.saveSpatialMemory('Nether Portal', 'Walk straight from the main base for 50 blocks', '10, 64, -20', './screenshots/nether_portal.jpg');

skills.name: mmskills.vision.takeScreenshot
skills.description: Takes a high-resolution screenshot of the current view and saves it to the specified file path.
